name: PERMAJU
recent: Permaju Industries Berhad 近期发生董事会变动，Koo Kien Yoon 卸任董事职务，并披露一项重大诉讼。公司最新季度营收环比增长但同比下滑，仍处于亏损状态。
notable: 董事会变动：MR KOO KIEN YOON 卸任。
公司披露一项重大诉讼。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 226.4 万令吉，净利率为 -82.0%。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 276 万令吉，环比增长 63.7%，同比下滑 54.7%；净亏损 226.4 万令吉，净利率 -82.0%，较上季度的 -283.1% 有所收窄。

recent_en: Permaju Industries Berhad recently saw a boardroom change with Mr Koo Kien Yoon ceasing to be a director, and disclosed a material litigation. Latest quarterly revenue rose QoQ but fell YoY, remaining loss-making.
notable_en: Boardroom change: MR KOO KIEN YOON ceased to be a director.
The company disclosed a material litigation.
risks_en: The company is involved in a material litigation.
Latest quarterly net loss was MYR 2.264 million with a net margin of -82.0%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2.76 million, up 63.7% QoQ but down 54.7% YoY; net loss was MYR 2.264 million with a net margin of -82.0%, narrower than -283.1% in the prior quarter.
